The Baritone screen, polished all the way through.

**It looks like the rest of Naughty or Nice now.** The same header as the main screen, with the search bar in it (a magnifier, the / key, an orange glow while you type), tabs with pictures and a gliding orange underline, and **light and dark**: the ☀ / ☾ button is here too and switches both screens. Buttons and rows fade on hover and click like the game's own.

**Easier to find your way.** Point at anything for a tooltip saying what it does. Every place on Go has an arrow pointing the way it is from where you're facing, in words too ("NE · ahead-left"), and Go shows where you are. The header names the job ("Following Griefer_Gary · 14 blocks"), and "Again ▾" holds what you did lately. ↑ ↓ and Enter work in every list.

**Mining smarter.** Pick an ore and it tells you where it's most common ("Diamonds are most common at Y -59"); Mine there sets the height range for you. While it mines: how many a minute, a bar towards your amount, and about how long is left.

**Safer.** Digging out an area, undoing all your settings and removing a saved spot ask "Sure?" first. Settings are edited right in their own row.

**Any window size.** At the Large screen size pages rearrange instead of squeezing: Mine puts the block list first with a bar along the bottom (options in a menu), Settings puts its groups and presets in menus.
